name: Coverage: from Luna 2 (1959) to 14/11/2026. Last landing: Hakuto-R M2 (05/06/2025). Last impact: Falcon 9 stage (05/08/2026).
Conventions: latitude positive to the north and negative to the south, longitude positive to the east and negative to the west, in decimal degrees. Times in UTC. Empty cell = unknown data.
Coordinates and times are given from memory or from press reports, including when reliability is low: to be verified (NASA NSSDCA, LROC, Phil Stooke "Moon Chronicle").
Altitude: column left empty, no reliable value available.
Crash column: oui = crash or impact (deliberate or not), non = landing (even if tipped over or damaged). Details are in the "event type" column.
Not included: orbiters whose end of life is not documented (Luna 10 to 12, 14, 19, 22, Lunar Orbiter 4), Peregrine (did not land), ascent stages of Apollo 11 and 16.
